/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=[r'long[- ]term debt', r'debt at year-end', r'year-end', r'long-term']
for i, t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    low=txt.lower()
    if any(re.search(p, low) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX', i, 'PAGE', t.get('page_no'), 'LABEL', t.get('label'), 'STRUCT', t.get('structure'))
        print(txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"
